scope.summary: Enforce the headless/quiet law: agent-driven Studio runs headless, no focus/keyboard/mouse steal, no window pop; every automation surface reachable via command API + Argus without OS input injection (negative-test harness asserts no automation surface responds to simulated global input); render/export processes hidden, owner-tagged, reclaimed.
acceptance_criteria: headless/quiet proven; no OS-input automation; no focus steal; processes reclaimed
expected_tests: negative: simulated global keyboard/mouse input triggers no Studio automation
test: focus/Z-order unchanged during agent run; processes reclaimed

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: Agent work steals focus / conflicts with operator; QUIET law violated.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
